subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What `session:prune` contract should OpenClaw support before this PR is ported: metadata-only with bounded sanitized fields, a broader trusted-content hook, or deferring the hook until a wider memory lifecycle design?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but maintainers need to choose what pruning/session metadata can leave the context path and whether hook delivery may block model-call preparation.

options.title: Metadata-only prune hook
options.body: Port this PR to the active path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

options.title: Trusted content hook
options.body: Allow richer pruned-content access only behind an explicit trusted hook/plugin policy with retention, timeout, and logging rules.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle design
options.body: Leave the PR open or replace it later if pruning, reset, and session-memory finalization should share one broader API.

recommendation.title: Metadata-only prune hook
recommendation.body: Port this PR to the active path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the implementation candidate and has adjacent hook-surface history, while the final contract can be reviewed with the active-path owner.
